name: young_man_thumbs_up
positive: A flat vector illustration of a young man with dark wavy hair and a short goatee. He is looking at the camera with a happy playful expression, raising his hand beside his face showing a clear thumbs up gesture: a closed fist with the thumb pointing upward, clearly visible inside the frame. He is wearing a light cream or beige shirt with an open collar. The art style is minimalist, clean, with flat color blocks and simple black outlines. Pure white background. Minimalist character design, head and shoulders portrait, generous white space around the subject, 1x1
